page.overview:
What is Raid on The Corner Shop?

Between around 62 BBY and 33 BBY, a raid occurred at a casino within The Corner Shop on the planet Duro during the Republic Era.

The raid first appeared in the "The Good Life," the fourth episode of the animated television miniseries Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld,
